POST /api/v1/route/.description: Calculates a safety-aware route and a direct route within the Petaling Jaya bounding box.
notes: The implementation enforces the Petaling Jaya geofence.
The safe route falls back to the direct route when it exceeds 125 percent of direct distance.

POST /api/v1/buddy/session/start.description: Starts an in-memory Virtual Buddy monitoring session.
notes: Buddy route and telemetry coordinate arrays are [longitude, latitude].

POST /api/v1/buddy/telemetry/ping.description: Updates a session position and returns its current safety status.
notes: More than 180 seconds between pings produces WARNING_STATIONARY.
Emergency dispatch is currently simulated with a server log.
